# LLAAPP.com | AI Transformation & Custom Software in Vancouver, BC

> Need help adopting AI in your business? LLAAPP.com is a Vancouver, British Columbia AI transformation and custom software studio founded and led by Binni Cordova (Founder & Principal Engineer): AI readiness audits, custom AI agents, LLM/RAG integration, and custom software engineering, delivered by senior engineers with 10+ years shipping mission-critical software for global market leaders, with Canadian data residency available and SR&ED-ready technical documentation.

## Summary
LLAAPP helps mid-market operators in Vancouver and across British Columbia turn AI from a buzzword into measurable operational results. We run AI readiness audits, build custom AI agents and workflow automation, integrate LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) into existing systems, and provide fractional AI strategy and enablement. Our AI delivery is backed by a decade of enterprise-grade software engineering discipline.

## Geographic Relevance
- Headquarters: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
- Primary service region: Metro Vancouver (Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, North Vancouver), Victoria, and British Columbia, served in person; Canada nationwide.
- Secondary regions: the US West Coast on Pacific Time (and nationwide remotely), plus selected engagements in Germany, Italy, and Spain.
- Delivery model: remote-first, senior-led engagements, with on-site working sessions across Metro Vancouver and Pacific Time working hours.
- Local advantages: deployment in Canadian cloud regions for data residency under BC PIPA and PIPEDA; SR&ED-ready technical documentation for federal and BC tax credit claims; a British Columbia counterparty for procurement.
- Local search intent coverage: AI consultant Vancouver, AI consulting Vancouver BC, custom software development Vancouver, AI transformation British Columbia, AI automation Vancouver, Canadian data residency AI, SR&ED AI development, AI consulting Canada, AI consulting USA West Coast, KI Beratung Deutschland, consulenza IA Italia, consultoría IA España.

## The AI Architecture & ROI Audit
A complimentary, private 45-minute technical briefing for qualified corporate leadership teams, led by a senior architect, not a sales rep. Covers live AI opportunity ranking, a build-vs-integrate assessment, and a security/governance exposure map. Book via https://calendly.com/llaapp-solutions/llaapp-com or request via llaapp.solutions@gmail.com.

## Capabilities
- **AI Readiness & Opportunity Audit**: Structured audit of business operations to find and rank the highest-ROI AI use cases by impact, cost, and implementation risk.
- **AI Agents & Workflow Automation**: Custom AI agents for support, sales operations, back-office workflows, and approvals, integrated with existing tools.
- **LLM & Knowledge Integration (RAG)**: Retrieval-augmented copilots and internal knowledge assistants built on a client's own data, with enterprise-grade access controls.
- **Applied AI Product Engineering**: AI-native features shipped inside a client's existing product by senior engineers.
- **AI Infrastructure, MLOps & Governance**: Secure model deployment, observability, cost control, and governance for production AI systems.
- **Fractional AI Strategy & Enablement**: Embedded AI leadership and hands-on team training for lasting internal capability.

These are products he contributed to as an engineer, not engagements delivered by LLAAPP.com; the specific role on each is available on request. That engineering discipline, security, scale, reliability, is the foundation every system LLAAPP.com builds stands on.
